title: TW-Builder
shortDescription: Fully client-side visual builder for creating Tailwind CSS components using familiar CSS concepts and generating deterministic Tailwind classes and JSX.
description: Fully client-side visual builder for creating Tailwind CSS components using familiar CSS concepts and generating deterministic Tailwind classes and JSX.

caseStudy.problem: Developers may know the visual CSS they want but still need to manually translate it into Tailwind utilities and JSX.
caseStudy.solution: Visual builder mapping semantic styling controls directly to Tailwind utilities via an ordered property registry.
features: div, button, input, img, section, and span controls
Layout, sizing, spacing, flex, and grid controls
Canonical token mapping with arbitrary pixel fallback
caseStudy.outcome: Lightweight browser-based developer tool with no backend, accounts, persistence or API dependency.
